title: N3on guides Crystal through knee lifts, sprint drills and a 35‑lb carry
description:
Clips from N3on's live streams on Kick (https://kick.com/n3on) | Unofficial fan channel, not affiliated.
N3on guides Crystal through a high‑intensity boot camp, starting with knee‑up drills and sprint gates. They move on to push‑ups, burpee broad jumps, bear crawls, and finish with hill climbs and cool‑down stretches. The session is full of encouragement, jokes, and real‑time adjustments for fatigue.
